section_b.title: Why This Matters
section_b.content: The creator distribution funnel is the modern economic conduit converting human seconds and neurological focus directly into financial liquidity. Unlike physical supply chains, this digital rail is governed by opaque recommendation algorithms and private ad auctions that extract high rents before creators receive any yield.

everyday_viewers.title: For Everyday Viewers
everyday_viewers.tagline: How your scroll time is financialized and extracted.

insights.headline: You Are the Liquidity Provider
insights.body: Every second you linger on a short-form clip, the platform's auction engine bids out your attention to 20+ ad exchanges in under 150 milliseconds.

insights.headline: Where Your Value Goes
insights.body: On platforms like TikTok and Instagram, less than 18% of the revenue generated by your viewing goes to the creator who made the video. The rest is retained as platform intermediary rent.

insights.headline: Ad Fatigue & Friction
insights.body: Platforms test your ad tolerance constantly. Once ad density exceeds 2.5 ads per 10 minutes, viewer session duration collapses by over 22% due to fatigue.

builders.title: For Builders & Creators
builders.tagline: Engineering conversion funnels that survive algorithmic gatekeepers.

insights.headline: The Walled Garden Tax
insights.body: Platforms deliberately suppress posts containing outbound links (up to 60% reach penalty). Builders must design multi-stage funnels (e.g. pinned comments, bio links, direct newsletters) to convert ephemeral viewers into owned subscribers.

insights.headline: Watch Time vs CTR Optimization
insights.body: Optimizing purely for algorithmic watch time creates high impressions but zero equity. Sustainable creator businesses require balancing high-CTR hooks with off-rail conversion mechanisms (Stripe, Substack, Shopify).

insights.headline: Monetization Stack Diversification
insights.body: Ad rev-share alone yields only $1.50-$18.00 CPM. Layering direct fan memberships and sponsorship overlays multiplies creator hourly yield by 4.2x.

allocators.title: For Allocators & Investors
allocators.tagline: Evaluating platform take-rates, network lock-in, and creator economics.

insights.headline: Heft of Platform Rents
insights.body: Distribution monopolies (Meta, ByteDance, Alphabet) command 45%-88% gross margins on creator attention rails because they control both the identity graph and the auction clearinghouse.

insights.headline: Power Law & Churn Vulnerability
insights.body: The top 1% of creators generate 72% of platform gross yield. When platforms reduce rev-share (e.g. Twitch 50/50 sub split), superstar creator defection accelerates audience churn to competing rails.

insights.headline: The Direct-to-Fan Opportunity
insights.body: Infrastructure rails that reduce take-rates from 80% to 10% (like Substack or decentralized creator rails) unlock massive LTV/CAC advantages for creators, creating fertile ground for capital allocation.

key_takeaways: Attention Latency: Beyond 2.5 ads/10m, session retention drops precipitously.
Walled Gardens: Platforms penalize external link CTR by up to 60% to trap audiences.
Power Law: 72% of total platform yield is concentrated in the top 1% creator tier.

section_c.title: Who Controls the Rail
section_c.quote: Platforms control the distribution of attention, turning users’ time and impressions into revenue while determining how earnings and economic power are shared with creators.

governance_vectors.mechanism: Opaque feed recommendation vectors dictate content velocity and impression discovery.
governance_vectors.impact: Decides which creator posts receive reach or suffer shadow suppression.

governance_vectors.mechanism: Second-price and header bidding exchanges set clearing CPMs with zero publisher transparency.
governance_vectors.impact: Captures 45% to 88% of advertiser spend before payout.

governance_vectors.mechanism: Unilateral rev-share adjustments without collective bargaining.
governance_vectors.impact: Platforms can cut creator payouts overnight (e.g. TikTok Creator Fund, Twitch 50/50 sub split).

Rising coverage of creator unionization, platform migration, and direct-to-fan subscription rails.
Growing consumer pushback against excessive ad loads in short-form video feeds.

stages.name: Post Impressions
stages.label: Algorithmic Discovery
stages.description: Total post appearances rendered in algorithmic user feeds across platforms.
stages.rail_mechanic: Gatekept by recommendation vectors and private ad auction bid density.
stages.leakage_factor: 95% of creator posts never clear the initial feed threshold.

stages.name: Engaged Watch Time
stages.label: Attention Retention
stages.description: Users who maintained focus beyond 3 seconds and consumed meaningful narrative bandwidth.
stages.rail_mechanic: Platform algorithmic ranking rewards completion rate over creator compensation.
stages.leakage_factor: 57.5% scroll away within the first 2 seconds.

stages.name: Click-Through (CTR)
stages.label: Direct Interaction
stages.description: Active user intent expressed via link clicks, bio navigation, or profile visits.
stages.rail_mechanic: Walled gardens actively penalize external links that bleed attention off-platform.
stages.leakage_factor: External link suppression reduces reach by up to 60% on Meta and X.

stages.name: Conversion Events
stages.label: High-Intent Actions
stages.description: Completed transactions: paid memberships, digital product sales, or sponsored lead signups.
stages.rail_mechanic: Conversion events build direct creator equity vs ephemeral platform engagement.
stages.leakage_factor: Payment processors and app store duopolies extract 15-30% in-app fees.

stages.name: Economic Gross Yield
stages.label: Liquid Value Realization
stages.description: Total financial yield generated from attention auctioned and creator equity realized.
stages.rail_mechanic: Intermediary rent extraction sets the ceiling on creator career sustainability.
